job.command:
stardev
module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
# Flatten jet_calibration/ and shared/ into the job's working dir. cp jet_calibration/* . cp shared/* .
echo "Compiling ApplyCorrections..." g++ -m64 ApplyCorrections.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o ApplyCorrections \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -std=c++11
set INDIR = "{{JETTREES_DIR}}" if ( "${INDIR}" !~ */ ) then set INDIR = "${INDIR}/" endif
# Evenly split every .root file across NPROCESSES jobs (contiguous # ranges) so no two jobs ever open the same file. ls ${INDIR}*.root | sort > all_files.list set NTOTAL = `wc -l < all_files.list` set NJOBS = {{NPROCESSES}}
@ base = ${NTOTAL} / ${NJOBS} @ rem = ${NTOTAL} % ${NJOBS}
if ( ${JOBINDEX} < ${rem} ) then @ mycount = ${base} + 1 @ mystart = ${JOBINDEX} * ${mycount} else @ mycount = ${base} @ mystart = ( ${rem} * ( ${base} + 1 ) ) + ( ( ${JOBINDEX} - ${rem} ) * ${base} ) endif
@ line_start = ${mystart} + 1 @ line_end = ${mystart} + ${mycount}
echo "========================================" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Total files = ${NTOTAL}, total jobs = ${NJOBS}" echo "This job's files: lines ${line_start}-${line_end} (${mycount} files)" echo "========================================"
sed -n "${line_start},${line_end}p" all_files.list > my_files.list cat my_files.list
if ( ${mycount} == 0 ) then echo "No files assigned to this job (nProcesses exceeds file count); nothing to do." else echo "Running ApplyCorrections..." ./ApplyCorrections my_files.list {{CALIB_JSON}} endif
# Temporary, job-local only; never meant to leave scratch. rm -f all_files.list my_files.list
echo "Done."
